about_the_game:
Welcome to Spoofs Playland!

Join your Spoof buddy and play minigames, unlock items and decorate your room, or just relax in a hand-drawn and animated world!

Check in every day to complete new quests, collect presents, write in your diary and expand your room!

Play together to build your friendship and discover hundreds of unlockable items, including new rooms to decorate, toys and stickers to display, and much more!

Spoofs Playland is non-linear. You can drop in, choose your favorite modes, and enjoy things at your own pace. Play your favorite games, complete quests or go fishing, fill in coloring pages, and write about your day!

Collect candy, shinies, and tickets and spend them at the Shop! Get new items, different Spoofs, and a wide selection of other playful and fun collectables. Make a sparkling garden, a cozy pillow place, or mix and match. There's something for everyone!

Features

  • Minigames! Try a variety of fun games that vary from the tried-and-true like "Memory" and "Sliding Puzzles" to original experiences like the intense "Millypog Pop", calming "Mansion Hide-and-Seek", and more!

  • Activities for Everyone! Want to go fishing? Fill in coloring pages? Play the piano? Every corner of Spoofs Playland has something to do, whether you want to get a high-score, express your creative side, or simply relax.

  • Decorate and Customize! Unlock new backgrounds, furniture, stickers, and toys! With hundreds of items to choose from, you can make a room that's uniquely yours.

  • Daily Quests and Goodies! Complete Quests from the daily quest board and earn big on missions given to you by the Spoofs and other friends! Earn fun presents just by logging in, too!

  • Bond with your Spoof! Your Spoof follows you everywhere you go! As you play and spend time together, you can raise your Bond Level and become better friends, bringing special rewards and events.

  • Trophies and unlockable secrets! Earn dozens of in-game trophies as you play to unlock unique room decorations and more...

  • Learning for the whole family! A selection of robust Learn modes lets you enjoy reading, spelling, counting, arithmetic, and more, perfect for anyone who wants to reinforce early classroom subjects or master the basics!

  • English/Spanish Toggle! At the tap of a button, you can instantly swap between the two languages, both of which are fully-featured with text graphics and voices! Choose your preferred language or improve your skills by practicing in the Learn modes!

  • Immerse yourself in a hand-drawn world! Traditionally-animated art comes to life in Spoofs Playland, where every toy, every creature, every single asset is hand-crafted in gorgeous, vibrant art!

short_description: Play, paint, fish, collect and decorate! Spoofs Playland is a relaxing, family-friendly collection of point-and-click minigames where you collect decorations and bond with the adorable Spoofs. Earn rewards, complete quests, buy new backgrounds and hundreds of items, and make your ideal room!
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
